jobs.title: Cyber Security Engineer
jobs.description: Requires 3+ years of experience. Bachelor’s degree, preferably in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field 3-6 years of prior internship, co-op, or work experience within Information Security or a related security role Practical exposure to security testing tools including Burp Suite, MobSF, SQLMap, Nmap, Nessus, and Shodan
